programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Steven Universe
programme.desc: The Crystal Gems are a team of magical beings who are the self-appointed guardians of the universe. Half-human, half-Gem hero Steven is the "little brother" of the group. The goofball is learning to save the world using the magical powers that come from his bellybutton and he goes on magical adventures with the rest of the Crystal Gems, even though he's not as powerful -- or smart -- as fellow group members Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl. Despite his shortcomings, Steven usually finds a surprising way to save the day. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy, Action)

programme.title: Mysteries of the Deep - NASA's Lost Treasure

programme.title: Tales From the Explorers Club - Polar Extremes
programme.desc: S1E2 - Josh Gates tackles history's most chilling polar adventures, including Robert Peary and Matthew Henson's brave push to the North Pole as well as Ernest Shackleton's epic survival in Antarctic ice.

programme.title: Tales From the Explorers Club - Highest Highs, Lowest Lows
programme.desc: S1E1 - Josh Gates recounts the death-defying exploits of Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay, who summit Mount Everest; two submariners plunge seven miles under the Pacific; a pilot skydives from the edge of space.

programme.title: Tales From the Explorers Club - Wild Rides
programme.desc: S1E4 - Josh Gates explores daring journeys, including the Kon-Tiki balsa raft crossing the Pacific, NASA's lunar rover making tracks on the moon and an airplane flying around the world without the use of fuel.

programme.title: Tales From the Explorers Club - Explorer's Club at the Movies
programme.desc: S1E6 - Josh Gates explores how club members' swashbuckling exploits inspired Hollywood; a bullwhip-cracking archaeologist may be the real-life Indiana Jones; a Nazi mountaineer's life-changing "Seven Years in Tibet" became a Brad Pitt star turn.

programme.title: Tales From the Explorers Club - The Race to Space
programme.desc: S1E3 - Josh Gates boldly explores members' most heart-pounding journeys into space; Apollo 13 astronauts fight to bring their crippled spacecraft 238,000 miles back to Earth and futuristic SpaceShipOne could give others a chance to travel to space.

programme.title: Expedition Files - Conspiracy Theories
programme.desc: S2E1 - Josh Gates investigates conspiracy theories, including new discoveries suggesting the Titanic was sunk by more than just an iceberg, the true story behind the death of Harry Houdini and lost Civil War gold that spawned a lawsuit against the FBI.

programme.title: Expedition Files - Mysterious Phenomena
programme.desc: S2E5 - Josh Gates looks closely at some of history's most intriguing hoaxes and unexplained events, including the Amityville Horror, the strange fate of a military submarine crew, and a phenomenon in which people's body fat causes them to burn alive.

programme.title: Expedition Files - Truth Vs. Tabloids
programme.desc: S4E7 - Josh Gates investigates sensationalistic stories, seeking the truth behind the unexplained: rock legend Jim Morrison's death, a bizarre, preserved mermaid found in a Japanese temple, and claims of alien abduction from a U.S. Airman.

programme.title: Expedition Files - Fateful Coverups
programme.desc: S4E3 - From a secret World War II unit that deceived Nazis, to the alleged crimes of the Knights Templar and a royal death tied to a scandal, Josh Gates explores mysteries built on coverups; was the truth buried to protect power, reputation and empires?

programme.title: Expedition Files - Mysteries of American History

programme.title: Gravity Falls
programme.desc: Twins Dipper and Mabel Pines are sent to spend the summer with their great-uncle, Grunkle Stan, in the mysterious town of Gravity Falls, Ore. Grunkle Stan has the kids help him run The Mystery Shack, the tourist trap that he owns. The twins try to adapt to the weird surroundings but sense there is something strange about Gravity Falls and begin to unlock its secrets. When Dipper uncovers a cryptic journal that offers insight into the town's mysteries, he and Mabel use it and their enthusiastic desire to vanquish evil to battle the imminent mysteries that surround them. (Animated, Children, Sitcom)

(Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Wars - Critter Christmas
programme.desc: S2E5 - The four remaining teams of cake and sugar artists must create the most bizarre visions of a Christmas party in the animal kingdom. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown - I'm Dreaming of a Bright Christmas
programme.desc: S1E3 - Host Jesse Palmer challenges the teams to create a holiday light show out of gingerbread and pair their glittering creations with the lightest of all desserts: choux pastry; judges Nacho Aguirre, Kardea Brown and Breegan Jane choose the winning team. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown - Best in Show
programme.desc: S1E1 - The baking teams are tasked with creating holiday memory snow globe scenes in gingerbread; they must also make a treat using the most common baking ingredient to represent snow — coconut. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown - Have Yourself a Scary Little Christmas
programme.desc: S1E2 - The Abominable Snowman inspires the challenge theme, "A Monster Christmas"; the teams must make an oozing caramel dessert to go with their display. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown - Holiday Window Shop 'til You Drop
programme.desc: S1E4 - The best part of shopping at the holidays is seeing all the window decorations, so the baking teams are asked to turn their favorite holiday window scene into a gingerbread display with an animated element and a champagne dessert. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Holiday Beauty
programme.desc: S10E5 - Jesse Palmer tasks the bakers with turning beautiful holiday designs into mini-tart mosaics; the bakers make merry and bright double-barrel wrapping paper cakes that feel like the perfect gift for judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller. (Reality, Cooking, Holiday)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Holiday Imagination
programme.desc: S10E6 - After learning the latke basics, Jesse Palmer has the bakers fry up latke-inspired desserts; the bakers' imaginations run wild while creating letterboard holiday bars to put judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller in the holiday spirit. (Reality, Cooking, Holiday)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Reasons for the Season
programme.desc: S10E7 - Jesse Palmer explores holiday traditions by challenging the bakers to craft Kwanzaa plantain desserts, make large edible ornaments and create puff pastry Christmas tree pull-aparts for judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller to tear into. (Reality, Cooking, Holiday)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Holiday Gifts Galore
programme.desc: S10E8 - Jesse Palmer leads three Christmas Eve challenges as the finalists upgrade Santa's cookies with macaron wreaths, stuff their stockings with éclairs and build showstopping holiday train cakes for the title of Holiday Baking Champion. (Reality, Cooking, Holiday)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Reasons for the Season
programme.desc: S10E7 - Jesse Palmer explores holiday traditions by challenging the bakers to craft Kwanzaa plantain desserts, make large edible ornaments and create puff pastry Christmas tree pull-aparts for judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller to tear into. programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Holiday Gifts Galore

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Shepherd's Pie and Sunday Dinner Sundaes
programme.desc: S3E10 - Noah Cappe visits the Big E in West Springfield, Mass., to try the turducken sandwich, Country Fried Shepherd's Pie, deep-fried fruit punch and The Big E-clair; Gwinnett County Fair in Georgia features Sunday Dinner Sundae and the Funnel Fried Bacon. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Dumplings and Pumpkins
programme.desc: S3E9 - Noah visits the North Florida Fair in Tallahassee for dead heat tacos, the bacon blast and the belly buster Philly cheesesteak; the Erin Fall Fair in Ontario, Canada serves up Ag Ladies apple dumplings, pork belly sliders and crackle lanterns. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Tournament of Champions - Down to the Great 8
programme.desc: S6E7 - Fieri welcomes the Great 8 back into the arena to compete in the tough quarterfinals; eight of the world's best chefs go head-to-head in four sudden death battles and deal with the randomizer to earn a trip to the finale. (Competition reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - The Time of Your Life
programme.desc: S13E2 - After a peppermint dessert preheat, Jesse Palmer asks the baking teams to make radical red velvet desserts in honor of Santa's fresh fit; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh choose the winner of the $1,000 prize package. (Reality, Cooking, Holiday)

programme.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking - The Chamber Challenge
programme.desc: S3E2 - James and Oliver Phelps ask the baking teams to bring the Basilisk, Moaning Myrtle, a Howler, and Hermione as a cat to life in their cakes; the showpieces are presented to judges Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain in the iconic Chamber of Secrets itself. (Cooking)

programme.title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas - The Holly Jolly Holiday Tournament Returns
programme.desc: S2E1 - Guy Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity. (Competition reality, Cooking, Holiday)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Turkey-Giving
programme.desc: S25E11 - In Princeton, N.J., a crêpe restaurant has a new take on a turkey club; in Somersworth, N.H., a turkey meatloaf and a haddock sandwich; in Louisville, Ky., a restaurant practices a pay-what-you-can business model. (Holiday, Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Bird and Beef
programme.desc: S28E4 - Guy Fieri travels the country, digging into awesome bird and beef; in Longmont, a fried chicken emporium serves up their specialty along with unique chicharrones. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Big Burgers to Little Italy
programme.desc: S29E6 - A funky joint in Little Rock, Ark., pairs their craft brews with all kinds of on-the-bun creations; two brothers put out real deal Italian food; a sandwich shop in Santa Rosa, Calif., dishes out all kinds of righteous recipes. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Whole Lotta Comfort
programme.desc: S30E2 - Hearty helpings of comfort include a soul food spot dishing out Southern seafood and killer fried chicken in Atlanta. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - A World of Barbecue
programme.desc: S32E1 - Guy Fieri is firing up an entire world of barbecue, from chicken salad in Delaware to Argentinian flavor in San Diego and a traditional Hawaiian pig roast down in the ground in Kauai, Hawaii. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Australian to Asian
programme.desc: S32E13 - A Japanese-Hawaiian spot putting a quick spin on fish, burgers and burritos; a bakery cooking up Down Under comfort food like meat pies and sausage rolls; a funky joint serving international mashups like Pasta Chihuahua and an oxtail tostada. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Bagels, Biscuit and Boar
programme.desc: S33E8 - Guy Fieri is diggin' into all kinds of flavor, starting in Santa Fe, N.M., at a pub serving comfort grub like chicken and biscuits and in-the-shell clam chowder. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Tacos, Tots and Chops
programme.desc: S41E7 - Guy Fieri enjoys a fun, filling fiesta, kicking off in Grand Junction, Colo., where a pub serves a real deal Reuben; a spot in Salt Lake City elevates tacos; an outrageous joint in Nashville, Tenn., cooks up Middle Eastern specialties. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Italian to Asian
programme.desc: S42E7 - Guy Fieri starts at a Vietnamese spot in Albuquerque, N.M., with banh mi; in Anchorage, Alaska, there's real Italian deli. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Beef and Bird
programme.desc: S44E5 - Loading up the meat with bomb beef and bird; in North Conway, N.H., a funky joint is putting Thai in their tacos, and a local gem in Emerald Isle, N.C., is firin' up big barbecue; in Taos, N.M., a traditional spot serves up New Mexican specialties. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Smoker, Stove and Skewer
programme.desc: S45E2 - Guy Fieri is checking out all kinds of culinary spots, like a Las Vegas food truck smoking up monster sandwiches and a California comfort spot with pot pie; a Mediterranean joint's beef skewers and tandoori chicken. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Flavor Explosion
programme.desc: S47E10 - Guy Fieri's diving into a flavor overload; a rockin' food truck in Mobile, AL, is dishing out next-level tacos, while an Indian joint in Alberta, Canada, is serving up street food with flair; in Los Angeles, a vegan oasis puts a spin on Bolognese. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.desc: S3E1 - This unique aerial voyage across Norway reveals the world's longest deep-sea cable, a 13th century church restoration and a breathtaking postal route.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack - Gulf Fear (New)
programme.desc: S8E6 - Gulf Shores, Alabama is an idyllic beach town and fishing haven on the Gulf of Mexico. Since 2000, this pocket of paradise has been ravaged by a series of terrifying shark attacks.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru and Brazil - Drugs And Divorce (New)
programme.desc: S1E3 - A divorced couple denies travelling together, but carry identical bags filled with cocaine. When a bag containing a white powder tests negative for cocaine, police decide to dig deeper.

programme.title: Yukon Vet - You Ain't Nothin' But a Hound Dog (New)
programme.desc: S10E1 - Dr Oakley treats a Sitka deer with a recurring limp, an alpaca-llama cross with an attitude, and guards the family dog from a wandering hound.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa - Canine Get a Witness (New)
programme.desc: S4E3 - As ZooTampa prepares for a birth, an orangutan mama breaks all the rules.

programme.title: Wild India - The Badlands (New)
programme.desc: In India's deserts, predators and prey battle each other and the harshest of landscapes for food, water and breeding rights.

programme.title: Wild India - The Monsoon Forest (New)
programme.desc: S1E2 - India's monsoon forest is a place of sanctuary and extremes. All live by the law of the seasons.

programme.title: Something Bit Me! - No Time to Be Terrified (New)
programme.desc: S1E8 - In the San Gabriel Mountains above Los Angeles, one false step turns a young couple's romantic hike into a desperate battle to save life and limb.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue - Winter's Payback (New)
programme.desc: S7E7 - When a huge supermarket truck crashes on the E6, Jo Roger asks his old friend and former employee Roger to make a comeback. In the southern mountains, Thord and Andrzej discover what it is like to have to be rescued.

programme.title: Casey and Brutus: Grizzly Encounters - Yellowstone Winter (New)
programme.desc: Casey treks deep into Yellowstone's wild backcountry, braving severe cold, freak snowstorms, and dangerous animal encounters. (Documentary, Animals)

programme.title: Snakes in the City - Cobra Chaos (New)
programme.desc: S9E5 - Simon and Sioux face a keelback snake stuck in a water tank. (Reality, Animals, Documentary)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Nerves of Steer (New)
programme.desc: S6E1 - Horses are driving Dr Pol wild as he works to fix chunky runny noses, gruesome gashes and even penile problems. He's always up to the challenge, but it's a horse of a different colour when Dr Pol is asked to deliver a commencement address to the entire graduating class of Central Michigan University. He's known for being good with his hands, but keeping his foot out of his mouth will be the real trick! (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Yukon Vet - Don't Have a Cow (New)
programme.desc: S11E9 - Dr. Oakley treats a kitten with a bulging eye, and Sierra preg checks a miniature cow. (Reality, Animals, Medical)

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans - Against the Wind (New)
programme.desc: S2E12 - Alaska Natives work to rebuild after an unprecedented storm surge flooded and devastated coastal villages. (Reality, Documentary, Outdoors, Adventure)

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment. (Shopping, Consumer)

programme.title: Bizarre Animal Friends - Hero Cat (New)
programme.desc: S2E5 - A boy is saved by his heroic family cat, a dog who mothers a goat, and a man who spoils his pet deer. (Documentary, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets - Lucky Ducky (New)
programme.desc: S2E4 - The doctors are heroes to huskies, make the endoscopy catch of a career and treat 100-pound snakes. (Animals, Pets, Reality)

programme.title: Snakes in the City - Snakes and Sewage (New)
programme.desc: S6E3 - To catch a deadly Black mamba, Simon must face his biggest fear - heights. And to save a spitting cobra, he deals with his OCD and digs in a pit. (Reality, Animals, Documentary)

programme.title: Animals Gone Wild - Danger Zone (New)
programme.desc: S2E7 - A circus lion resists captivity, open water swimmers get a surprise visit from a pair of whales, and a dog is left on the wrong side of a door. (Documentary, Animals)

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - The Big Blue (New)
programme.desc: S1E3 - Every year, thousands of people flock to the ocean and encounter marine fauna. From an octopus slapping a kayaker to a sea snake trying to befriend a human, we explore the most unusual and amusing behaviours of the ocean's most sociable creatures. (Documentary)

programme.title: Heartland Docs, DVM - Lovebirds, Actually (New)

programme.title: Kingdom of the Apes: Battle Lines (New)

programme.title: Europe From Above - Croatia (New)

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru and Brazil - Suitcase Saturation (New)
programme.desc: S1E4 - A mother with a drug-saturated package in her suitcase says she is also being sent to work as a prostitute. A man claims drugs taped to his body are for personal use. A long-lost bag contains cocaine. (Documentary, Crime)

programme.title: Yukon Vet - This Little Piggy Had An Ouchie (New)
programme.desc: S10E6 - The team expresses a piglet's enormous lump. (Reality, Animals, Medical)

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa - Crash Course (New)
programme.desc: S4E4 - Upgrades are underway in Florida Wilds; a rhino makes new friends. (Animals, Nature)

programme.title: Magic of Disney's Animal Kingdom - Kenya, the Gutsy Giraffe (New)
programme.desc: S1E1 - A giraffe gets a pedicure; an elephant check-up reveals a mouthful; a rescued chicken with an egg problem requires surgery; a dolphin gets a high-tech exam. (Documentary, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Magic of Disney's Animal Kingdom - Happy Birthday, Gino! (New)
programme.desc: S1E2 - Gino, a western lowland gorilla, celebrates his 39th birthday; Lori notices a lump on lioness Kinsey which requires medical attention; Amanda prepares to welcome a spotted eagle ray pup into the world; Katelyn teaches navigation skills to two macaws. (Documentary, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Something Bit Me! - If She Smells I'm Alive... (New)
programme.desc: S1E9 - Whether weighing half a ton or just 4 pounds, two predators pack a punch. - George Clyde, Clyde George, Tara Burke Lewis, Mike Nyman (Documentary, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue - Police Hold-Up (New)
programme.desc: S7E8 - Thord and Bjorn have a tough time when the police stop them midway through the rescue of a 35-tonne truck. Up north, Jo Roger tries to rescue a truck carrying 10 tonnes of salmon. (Reality, Travel, Nature, Outdoors)

programme.title: Built To Survive - Wet and Wild Rainforests (New)
programme.desc: S1E1 - In the heat and humidity of the rainforest, Phil reveals the survival adaptations of the elusive tree kangaroo, the colourful cassowary, and the lethal scrub python. (Documentary)

programme.title: Casey and Brutus: Grizzly Encounters - Growing Up Grizzly (New)
programme.desc: Casey throws a big birthday bash for his pet grizzly bear Brutus, before introducing him to some new friends at the Montana Grizzly Encounter sanctuary. (Documentary, Animals)

programme.title: Snakes in the City - Monster Python (New)
programme.desc: S9E6 - It is monsoon season in Mysore and there are snakes everywhere. Giant pythons, deadly Russell's vipers, cobras and rat snakes. (Reality, Animals, Documentary)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - The Upper Hoof (New)
programme.desc: S5E9 - It's a full day for the vets when Dr Pol deals with a foursome of gutsy cows that refuse their pregnancy checks and Dr Brenda deals with an after-hours emergency when Sisco the horse is down with colic. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Yukon Vet - Eagles and Beagles (New)

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans - Taken by the Wolf (New)

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets - Little Graft (New)

programme.title: Snakes in the City - The Dark Night (New)

programme.title: Animals Gone Wild - Epic Fails (New)

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - Safari Showdown (New)

programme.title: Heartland Docs, DVM - Heart and Foal (New)
programme.desc: S4E11 - The docs assist a kitten with a dangly leg, save a St. Bernard puppy in the throes of kidney failure, and outfit a Bichon with some cool new shades. (Reality, Animals)

A team of investigators uncover clues in their search for the truth. - David A. Ebert (Documentary, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru and Brazil - Undercover Operation (New)

programme.title: Up in the Air
programme.desc: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own. - George Clooney, Vera Farmiga, Anna Kendrick (Movies, Comedy Drama)

programme.desc: A Navy admiral (Gene Hackman) orders the rescue of a fighter pilot (Owen Wilson) after the Serbs shoot down his plane in Bosnia. - Owen Wilson, Gene Hackman, Gabriel Macht (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat. - Tom Hanks, Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore (Movies, War)

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: Some of the servicemen who raised the U.S. flag on Mount Suribachi during the Battle of Iwo Jima at the end of World War II live to hear of their status as heroes. - Ryan Phillippe, Jesse Bradford, Adam Beach (Movies, War)

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: A troubled Gulf War veteran (Denzel Washington) becomes suspicious after a powerful senator's (Meryl Streep) son (Liev Schreiber) becomes a candidate for vice president. - Denzel Washington, Meryl Streep, Liev Schreiber (Movies, Thriller)

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams. - Julianne Hough, Diego Boneta, Russell Brand (Movies, Musical)

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, Takeshi Kitano (Movies, Sci-Fi)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: A troubled Gulf War veteran (Denzel Washington) becomes suspicious after a powerful senator's (Meryl Streep) son (Liev Schreiber) becomes a candidate for vice president. - Denzel Washington, Meryl Streep, Liev Schreiber (Movies, Thriller)

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. - Denzel Washington, Pedro Pascal, Ashton Sanders (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection - Camera Shy
programme.desc: Dexter embeds himself in New York's ride-share community to track down a serial killer; Harrison spirals from the guilt of a violent outburst. - Michael C. Hall, Jack Alcott, James Remar (Drama)

programme.title: It Gets Worse - Ethan
programme.desc: Newly evicted best friends Ethan, Abi and Sam escape reality with one last unforgettable night out at a London gay club; but when long-buried tensions surface, the trio must confront whether their friendship can survive the fallout. - Emily Fairn, Olive Gray, Leo Reich (Comedy)

programme.title: It Gets Worse - Abi
programme.desc: Abi has it all: a flat with her boyfriend, a new promotion, a more adult life; but beneath the surface, cracks are beginning to show; the trio reunite at a dinner party, which forces Abi to look closer at her seemingly perfect life. - Emily Fairn, Olive Gray, Leo Reich (Comedy)

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson (Movies, Comedy Drama)

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays. - Mila Kunis, Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn (Movies, Holidays, Comedy)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos. - Bailey Chase, Neal McDonough, Dawn Olivieri (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: The Outsiders
programme.desc: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang. - Matt Dillon, C. Thomas Howell, Ralph Macchio (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A bungling gangster (Brad Pitt) must reform to please his girlfriend (Julia Roberts) but still has one last job to fulfill. - Brad Pitt, Julia Roberts, James Gandolfini (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship. - Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Carrie Fisher (Movies, Romance)

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot. - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel. - Tom Cruise, Rebecca De Mornay, Bronson Pinchot (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: A teenage girl (Hailee Steinfeld) enlists the aid of a boozy, trigger-happy lawman (Jeff Bridges) to hunt down her father's killer (Josh Brolin). - Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon, Josh Brolin (Movies, Western)

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface. - Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Arian Moayed, Kaia Gerber, Este Haim (Drama, Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood. - Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Emma Watson, Ray Winstone, Anthony Hopkins (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical drama, Movie)

programme.title: The King's Speech
programme.desc: England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence. - Colin Firth, Geoffrey Rush, Helena Bonham Carter, Guy Pearce, Timothy Spall (Biography, Drama, Historical drama, History, Movie)

programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench). - Daniel Day-Lewis, Marion Cotillard, Penélope Cruz, Nicole Kidman, Judi Dench (Drama, Movie, Music, Musical, Romance)

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up. - Matthew McConaughey, Steve Zahn, Penélope Cruz, Lennie James, Lambert Wilson (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Morning Glory
programme.desc: Newly hired as a producer on a national morning-news program called "Daybreak," Becky Fuller (Rachel McAdams) decides to revitalize the low-rated show by bringing in legendary anchorman Mike Pomeroy (Harrison Ford). Pomeroy, however, refuses to do puff pieces like celebrity gossip and fashion, and clashes with his co-host (Diane Keaton). Meanwhile, Becky's romance with a colleague begins to unravel, leaving her struggling to save her relationship, her job and the show. - Rachel McAdams, Harrison Ford, Diane Keaton, Dermot O'Leary, Olivia Lee (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance)

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. - Nicolas Cage, Michael Peña, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Maria Bello, Connor Paolo (Drama, History, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: You Can Count on Me
programme.desc: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt. - Laura Linney, Mark Ruffalo, Rory Culkin, Matthew Broderick, Jon Tenney (Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Everybody's Fine
programme.desc: Eight months after the death of his wife, Frank Goode looks forward to a reunion with his four adult children. When all of them cancel their visits at the last minute, Frank, against the advice of his doctor, sets out on a road trip to reconnect with his offspring. As he visits each one in turn, Frank finds that his children's lives are not quite as picture-perfect as they've made them out to be. - Robert De Niro, Drew Barrymore, Kate Beckinsale, Sam Rockwell, Melissa Leo (Comedy drama, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. - Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway, Rene Russo, Anders Holm, JoJo Kushner (Comedy, Comedy drama, Movie)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Kevin Spacey, Jennifer Aniston (Comedy, Crime, Movie)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: Tired of always answering to others, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) go into business for themselves. After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Chris Pine (Comedy, Movie)

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. - Charles Esten, Oded Fehr, Brec Bassinger, Joel Johnstone, Lauren Call (Drama)

programme.title: Wildling
programme.desc: After a childhood in captivity under the care of a man who taught her to fear the outside world, a young woman sees her new freedom shattered by a series of unsettling events. - Liv Tyler, Brad Dourif, Bel Powley, James Le Gros, Mike Faist (Horror, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
programme.desc: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. - Johnny Depp, Helena Bonham Carter, Alan Rickman, Timothy Spall, Sacha Baron Cohen (Musical, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Hostage
programme.desc: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family. - Bruce Willis, Kevin Pollak, Ben Foster, Jonathan Tucker, Marshall Allman (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. - Morgan Freeman, Monica Potter, Michael Wincott, Penelope Ann Miller, Michael Moriarty (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Mark Ruffalo, Ben Kingsley, Max von Sydow, Michelle Williams (Thriller, Mystery, Drama)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple). - Matthew McConaughey, Emile Hirsch, Juno Temple, Gina Gershon, Thomas Haden Church (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. - Aaron Eckhart, Hilary Swank, Delroy Lindo, Stanley Tucci, D.J. Qualls (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: American Son
programme.desc: A freshly graduated Marine returns home to his dysfunctional family for Thanksgiving. - Nick Cannon, Melonie Diaz, Matt O'Leary, Jay Hernandez, Erica Gluck (Drama)

programme.title: Domestic Disturbance
programme.desc: Frank Morrison (John Travolta) no longer lives with his ex-wife, Susan (Teri Polo), and 12-year-old son, Danny (Matt O'Leary). Susan and Danny now live with Rick Barnes (Vince Vaughn), Susan's new husband. Danny, who has a reputation for telling lies, has accused his stepfather of committing a murder. But Frank is the only one who believes him. Now the father Danny trusts must protect him from the stepfather he fears. - John Travolta, Vince Vaughn, Teri Polo, Matt O'Leary, Ruben Santiago-Hudson (Thriller)

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. - Jennifer Lawrence, Max Thieriot, Elisabeth Shue, Gil Bellows, Eva Link (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. - Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Brendan Gleeson, Bill Paxton, Jonas Armstrong (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. - Idris Elba, Matthew McConaughey, Tom Taylor, Claudia Kim, Fran Kranz (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. - Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin, John Goodman, Victor Garber (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography)

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: Tourists fall prey to carnivorous vines ensnaring the ruins of an ancient Mayan temple.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A bungling gangster (Brad Pitt) must reform to please his girlfriend (Julia Roberts) but still has one last job to fulfill.

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: Two bullets force a career-driven Manhattan lawyer (Harrison Ford) to start life over with his loving wife (Annette Bening) and daughter.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: A one-time tennis professional (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) becomes obsessed with his brother-in-law's (Matthew Goode) seductive fiancée (Scarlett Johansson).

programme.title: Haunter
programme.desc: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living.

programme.title: The Butcher's Wife
programme.desc: A folksy seaside clairvoyant (Demi Moore) marries a New York butcher (George Dzundza), moves to the city and charms her new neighbors.

programme.title: A Very Brady Sequel
programme.desc: A man claiming to be Carol Brady's long-lost first husband, Roy Martin, shows up at the suburban Brady residence one evening.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. - Jennifer Aniston, Jason Sudeikis, Will Poulter, Emma Roberts, Ed Helms (Comedy, Action, Crime drama)

programme.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
programme.desc: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician. - Miya Cech, Rhea Perlman, Leonardo Nam, Kannon, Paulina Lule (Comedy)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. - Nicole Kidman, Matthew Broderick, Bette Midler, Glenn Close, Christopher Walken (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction)

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. - Helen Mirren, Jason Clarke, Sarah Snook, Angus Sampson, Laura Brent (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. - Elizabeth Banks, Emily Browning, Arielle Kebbel, David Strathairn, Jesse Moss (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. - Ellen Page, Sam Keeley, Tom Vaughan-Lawlor, Stuart Graham, Peter Campion (Horror, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Haunter
programme.desc: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. - Abigail Breslin, Stephen McHattie, Peter Outerbridge, Michelle Nolden, David Hewlett (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. - Adam Sandler, Jennifer Aniston, Nicole Kidman, Nick Swardson, Brooklyn Decker (Romantic comedy, Comedy)

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater. - Gillian Jacobs, Jemaine Clement, Josh Wiggins, Forrest Goodluck, Khloe Janel (Comedy)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Gemma Jones, Jim Broadbent (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. - Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant, Colin Firth, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Proof
programme.desc: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Anthony Hopkins, Jake Gyllenhaal, Hope Davis, Gary Houston (Drama)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. - Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway, Rene Russo, Anders Holm, JoJo Kushner (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Up in the Air
programme.desc: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light. - George Clooney, Vera Farmiga, Anna Kendrick, Jason Bateman, Danny McBride (Comedy drama, Romance)

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity. - John Cusack, Kate Beckinsale, Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven, John Corbett (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them. - Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Carrie Fisher, Bruno Kirby, Steven Ford (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons. - Patrick Swayze, Demi Moore, Whoopi Goldberg, Tony Goldwyn, Rick Aviles (Fantasy, Romance, Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: Zack Mayo (Richard Gere), a new member of the U.S. Navy, has a bad attitude. When he signs up for the Aviation Academy, he is met with the strict leadership of Sgt. Emil Foley (Louis Gossett Jr.), who gives Zack a rude awakening in terms of relating with other people. Through Foley's guidance -- and an unexpected romance with Paula (Debra Winger), an outsider who hangs around the naval base -- Zack learns some tough lessons and discovers what he truly wants out of life. - Richard Gere, Debra Winger, Louis Gossett Jr., David Keith, Robert Loggia (Drama)

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. - Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon, Josh Brolin, Barry Pepper, Hailee Steinfeld (Western, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater. - Gillian Jacobs, Jemaine Clement, Josh Wiggins, Forrest Goodluck, Khloe Janel (Comedy)

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. - Dennis Quaid, Sarah Jessica Parker, Thomas Haden Church, Ellen Page, Ashton Holmes (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Grumpy Old Men
programme.desc: John Gustafson (Jack Lemmon) and Max Goldman (Walter Matthau) are two curmudgeonly neighbors who have been at each other's throats for years. The rivalry of the former friends intensifies when Ariel (Ann-Margret) comes along and provides a love interest for both of them. When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend. - Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Ann-Margret, Daryl Hannah, Buck Henry (Comedy)

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him. - Jay Baruchel, Alice Eve, T.J. Miller, Mike Vogel, Nate Torrence (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret. - Richard Gere, Jennifer Lopez, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Lisa Ann Walter (Romantic comedy, Drama, Music)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Racing With the Moon
programme.desc: In their last weeks before deployment to World War II as Marines, teenage friends Henry Nash (Sean Penn) and Nicky (Nicolas Cage) try to make the best of the time they have left in their small California town. When Nash spots Caddie Winger (Elizabeth McGovern), a new girl in town he mistakenly believes to be wealthy, he sets about winning her over. But the good times are ruined when Nicky finds himself trying to solve a serious predicament, and implicating Nash and Caddie in the process. - Sean Penn, Elizabeth McGovern, Nicolas Cage, John Karlen, Rutanya Alda (Romance)

programme.desc: An inexperienced college student (Dakota Johnson) begins a daring affair with a controlling businessman (Jamie Dornan) whose sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure.

programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: A woman's dream of becoming a news anchor is jeopardized by an ill-advised tryst that leaves her stranded in downtown Los Angeles with no money or transportation and only eight hours to make it to the most important job interview of her life.

programme.title: The 40 Year-Old Virgin

programme.title: Enough
programme.desc: After running away fails, a terrified woman (Jennifer Lopez) empowers herself in order to battle her abusive husband (Billy Campbell).

programme.title: Fifty Shades of Grey (Extended Version)
programme.desc: When college senior Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan) for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure. - Dakota Johnson, Jamie Dornan, Jennifer Ehle, Eloise Mumford, Victor Rasuk (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Fifty Shades Darker: Extended Version
programme.desc: When a wounded Christian Grey tries to entice a cautious Anastasia Steele back into his life, she demands a new arrangement before she will give him another chance. As the two begin to build trust and find stability, shadowy figures from Christian's past start to circle them, determined to destroy their hopes for a future together. - Dakota Johnson, Jamie Dornan, Eric Johnson, Eloise Mumford, Bella Heathcote (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Fifty Shades Freed: Extended Version
programme.desc: Believing they've left behind the shadowy figures from the past, billionaire Christian Grey and his new wife, Anastasia, fully embrace their inextricable connection and shared life of luxury. Just as the Greys begin to step into their new roles, sinister events come to light and jeopardize their happy ending before it even begins. - Dakota Johnson, Jamie Dornan, Eric Johnson, Rita Ora, Luke Grimes (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Marshall
programme.desc: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty. - Chadwick Boseman, Josh Gad, Kate Hudson, Sterling K. Brown, Dan Stevens (Historical drama, Biography)

programme.title: Curve
programme.desc: A young woman becomes trapped in her wrecked car after a hitchhiker causes an accident. - Julianne Hough, Teddy Sears, Madalyn Horcher, Penelope Mitchell, Drew Rausch (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
programme.desc: When Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.) jump-starts a dormant peacekeeping program, things go terribly awry, forcing him, Thor (Chris Hemsworth), the Incredible Hulk (Mark Ruffalo) and the rest of the Avengers to reassemble. As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Along the way, they encounter two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff. - Robert Downey Jr., Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Evans, Scarlett Johansson (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet. - Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Michelle Monaghan, Peter Dinklage, Josh Gad (Comedy, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Night Before
programme.desc: For the last 10 years, lifelong buddies Ethan (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), Isaac (Seth Rogen) and Chris (Anthony Mackie) have gathered on Christmas Eve to celebrate the holidays with a bang. As Isaac prepares to become a first-time father, the friends realize that their annual tradition is coming to a sad end. To make it as memorable as possible, they plan a night of debauchery and hilarity by searching for the Nutcracka Ball, the Holy Grail of Christmas parties in New York. - Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Seth Rogen, Anthony Mackie, Jillian Bell, Lizzy Caplan (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. - Matt Damon, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Cate Blanchett, Philip Seymour Hoffman (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance)

programme.title: Enough
programme.desc: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman. - Jennifer Lopez, Billy Campbell, Juliette Lewis, Dan Futterman, Fred Ward (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Brick Mansions
programme.desc: In a dystopian Detroit, grand houses that once housed the wealthy are now homes of the city's most-dangerous criminals. Surrounding the area is a giant wall to keep the rest of Detroit safe. For undercover cop Damien Collier (Paul Walker), every day is a battle against corruption as he struggles to bring his father's killer, Tremaine (RZA), to justice. Meanwhile, Damien and an ex-con named Lino (David Belle) work together to save the city from a plot to destroy it. - Paul Walker, David Belle, RZA, Goûchy Boy, Catalina Denis (Action, Crime drama)

programme.title: Dìdi
programme.desc: In 2008, during the last month of summer before high school begins, an impressionable 13-year-old Taiwanese American boy learns what his family can't teach him: how to skate, how to flirt, and how to love his mom. - Izaac Wang, Joan Chen, Shirley Chen, Chang Li Hua, Mahaela Park (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Pixels

programme.desc: S2E8 - Julia and Lovat attend an event honoring Loyalist Lairds who fought against Jacobites in the Rebellion; Ellen's longstanding plan to protect Leoch from the Crown is put to the test. - Harriet Slater, Jamie Roy, Hermione Corfield, Jeremy Irvine, Tony Curran (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles - The Project
programme.desc: S1E7 - A deadly new drug, smuggled inside donut deliveries, pulls the Exiles into an undercover operation; meanwhile, Malik's abrupt transfer sends shockwaves through the squad, but only Hondo and Ethan know just how deep undercover he's about to go. - Shemar Moore, Lucy Barrett, Adain Bradley, Zyra Gorecki, Freddy Miyares (Crime drama, Action)

programme.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles - Edgemont (New)
programme.desc: S1E8 - Sammy steps up to lead the team through its most delicate hostage situation yet when a former student returns to his old campus armed and hunting the people who failed him; the Exiles start to realize the real threat might already be wearing a badge. - Shemar Moore, Lucy Barrett, Adain Bradley, Zyra Gorecki, Freddy Miyares (Crime drama, Action)

programme.title: Miss Bala
programme.desc: Young Gloria seeks help from the police when cartel hit men kidnap her friend from a nightclub in Mexico. She soon finds herself in big trouble when a corrupt cop hands her over to the same goons who shot up the place. Their gang leader, Lino, decides to use Gloria for his dirty work to avoid detection from the Drug Enforcement Administration. Determined to get away, Gloria must now play a dangerous game to outwit not only the cartel, but the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity. - Gina Rodriguez, Ismael Cruz Córdova, Anthony Mackie, Cristina Rodlo, Matt Lauria (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Adventure)

programme.title: In the Grey
programme.desc: A covert team of elite operatives live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival. - Jake Gyllenhaal, Henry Cavill, Eiza González, Kristofer Hivju, Fisher Stevens (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built. - Daniel MacPherson, Russell Crowe, Luke Hemsworth, Mojean Aria, Nathan Phillips (Action, Drama)

programme.title: A Richer Christmas
programme.desc: When a wealthy family loses everything before the holidays, their world falls apart - but in the chaos, they discover the true meaning of Christmas. - Tobias Truvillion, Teresa Celeste, Karlie Redd, Sencere Brown, Allen C. Shepherd Sr. (Holiday, Drama)

programme.title: Another Merry Deranged Holy Unhinged Christmas Affair
